hints.hint: Use `(∀ s ∈ C, IsOpen s) → IsOpen (⋃₀ C)`; when `C = ∅`, this derives openness of `∅`.
The second field is `(C : Set (Set α)) → (∀ s ∈ C, IsOpen s) → IsOpen (⋃₀ C)`.
The third field is `∀ s t, IsOpen s → IsOpen t → IsOpen (s ∩ t)`.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : T4.MyTopology α) : τ.IsOpen Set.univ := τ.isOpen_univ
checks.message: `isOpen_univ` must state exactly that the universal set is open.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : T4.MyTopology α) (C : Set (Set α)) (h : ∀ s ∈ C, τ.IsOpen s) : τ.IsOpen (⋃₀ C) := τ.isOpen_sUnion C h
checks.message: `isOpen_sUnion` must accept every family of open sets.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : T4.MyTopology α) (s t : Set α) (hs : τ.IsOpen s) (ht : τ.IsOpen t) : τ.IsOpen (s ∩ t) := τ.isOpen_inter s t hs ht
checks.message: `isOpen_inter` must conclude openness of the intersection, not the union.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : T4.MyTopology α) : τ.IsOpen ∅ := by simpa using τ.isOpen_sUnion ∅ (by simp)
checks.message: Openness of the empty set should follow from the empty union.
